rationale: This mutation eliminates the $9,083 cash deficit by raising the contiguous plot ceiling to 20-24 by Day 13 with 10-11 hands, fully utilizing workforce capacity while freezing late land purchases and dedicating 100% of Day 5+ acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries. It decouples daytime reinvestment from midnight wage defense (1.0x payroll reserve during hours 04:00-17:00) and introduces a two-tier liquidation threshold (>=0.84x base normal, >=0.78x base midday) to unlock fluid capital velocity without premature step 680 dumping. Crucially, farm execution restores pre-seed hyper-fertilization at Priority 2 while strictly defending in-situ harvest-and-water at Priority 1 to prevent recurring crop regrowth pauses.
